training_generation: generate_profiles(cfg, independent_seed), never apply_profile_overrides; multiply each already-clipped renewable actual/DA/ID/RT series by declared renewable multiplier once, then clip to nameplate. Frozen load_scale already includes evaluation load multiplier; do not scale load again.
information_boundary: Only evaluation DA forecast, fixed tie schedule, resolved DA bids, configuration and declared scenario multiplier used. No evaluation actual/ID/RT value read. Synthetic training actual is independently generated.
distribution_boundary: Forward-generator unconditional clock-time error samples; not actual given observed DA posterior, not measured history, not empirical probability calibration. Actual-to-forecast clipping and all generator temporal/cross-resource correlations preserved.
anchor_blocks: [00:00,02:00),...,[22:00,24:00); each eight 15-minute periods. B varies within block; not a single blockwide constant. No next-day wrap.
B_scope: Forward capacity envelope using known DA ramps; does not guarantee that capacity, operating mode, inventory or network delivery can transfer across times.
implementation_if_approved: DA case.R_up=baseline_R_up+chosen_buffer; preserve RT original requirement and all physical/economic inputs. No change made now.
